name: Strafperlaggen
description: Strafperlaggen is a variant of Perlaggen, a traditional Tyrolean card game, typically played by 3 players. It uses a 33-card German-suited deck (Weli is the 33rd card). Similar to Perlaggen, players aim to win 'figures' (Gleich, Hanger, Spiel). The 'Straf' (Penalty) aspect likely refers to stricter rules or penalty points for failures.

history.origins: Perlaggen appeared in the Tyrol in the early 19th century; the first comprehensive rules were published in 1853 (Das Tiroler National- oder Perlagg-Spiel) and the game was recognised by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2016. Strafperlaggen is a three-player variant played in and around Hall and Absam, east of Innsbruck, which adds penalty points (Strafpunkte) for betting or holding a figure and failing to win it.
history.cultural: Serious strategic game with specific terminology.
history.evolution: Strafperlaggen adds layers of bluffing and penalties.

setup.players: Three players only; each plays for themselves.
setup.deck: 33-card German-suited pack (32 cards plus Weli, the Six of Bells).
setup.dealing: Seven cards each: deal 3 each, turn trump (if acorn turn until non-acorn), then 4 each. Dealer may exchange natural trump for turned Perlagg or acorns for acorn Perlaggen.

rules.objective: First player to reach zero points wins. Start with 9 points; deduct for winning a figure (Gleich, Hanger, Spiel); add penalty points (Strafpunkte) if you bet or hold and fail to win.
rules.gameplay: Three players, seven cards each. Trump turned (acorns cannot be trumps). Four tricks needed to win Spiel. Players may bet on Gleich, Hanger or Spiel; opponents concede, hold or raise. Winner of Spiel begins the show to resolve Gleich and Hanger. Unbet figures scored in order: Spiel, Gleich, Hanger.
keyRules: Must follow suit or play trump; Perlaggen baptised when played.
Bet or hold and lose adds 2 or 3 penalty points.
Player with 1 point may not bet or raise.
Acting out of turn or failing to show a figure adds 2-point penalty.

strategy.basic: Use Perlaggs (Wilds) to complete figures. Bluffing is huge. Bet on a weak Hanger to scare opponents. If they fold, you win the point without showing.
strategy.intermediate: The 'Weli' Usage: It's the permanent 2nd highest trump? No, Perlaggs have specific ranks. Know the hierarchy perfectly.
strategy.advanced: Straf-Calculation: Force opponents into bad bets. If they bet and lose, they get penalty points (Straf points).
tips: Never show your cards unless challenged.
